scenarios: Black-box cards receive holdout/ and the harness; implement/diff cards never do
rigor=high panels fail closed unless every expected lane passes
refactor cards pin behavior, perf cards embed the 7+7 benchmark checklist, and investigate rejects skip_define and spawns a read-only `[define] [investigate]` card that writes only investigation.md

Definition cards (feature, bug, refactor, perf, investigate) gain a bounded `## Prior Institutional Memory (Recall)` section with no holdout references only when other workstreams' memory matches; quick / skip_define cards never do; results carry additive recall_count
A holdout reference in a prior decision's tenant, phase, card_id or correction never reaches a Definition card; the recall section is dropped if any reference survives redaction

Control and format characters interleaved in a holdout path (NUL, BEL, ESC, zero-width) are deleted, not spaced, before redaction, so no fragment of the path reaches recall output or a Definition card; Definition-card recall matches history logged under the registered owner/repo or its slug

A holdout path containing spaces (quoted or unquoted, in directory or filename) or whitespace-interleaved before a path separator (`hol<TAB>dout/x`) withholds the whole recalled field as [redacted], so no scenario-name suffix reaches a Definition card

Complete terminal escape sequences (ANSI CSI such as `ho<ESC>[31mldout`, OSC, DCS and 8-bit C1 forms) inside a holdout path are stripped before matching, so the whole recalled field becomes [redacted] and no scenario name reaches a Definition card, while colored non-holdout text is not redacted

scenarios: `arena spawn` fails closed (exit 1, zero Kanban cards) unless candidates span >= 2 distinct known vendor families; `--strict-cross-vendor` rejects an overlapping or unknown judge before any card exists
Each candidate writes only to runs/<tenant>/arena/<arena_id>/candidates/<slot>/; design candidates and the design judge never receive a holdout/ path
The judge card depends on every candidate (parents) and is told to hand-graft the canonical artifact citing each candidate's strengths and risks and log arena_synthesis

`arena status --json` reads kanban.db read-only and reports ready_for_synthesis / synthesized / canonical_artifact_exists; `synthesized` requires every candidate done with an artifact, a done judge and a canonical artifact changed since canonical_baseline; archived candidates read degraded, failed/cancelled candidates or judge read needs_attention, and an unreadable canonical artifact is never synthesized

`--spawn-judge` creates a missing judge exactly once, reusing the saved judge model and persisted strict_cross_vendor and reporting its real Kanban status; a failure on any arena card rolls back every card and the arena directory; a deferred judge whose manifest write fails is rolled back (zero judge card, unchanged manifest, CLI JSON error + exit 1) and a retry succeeds

scenarios: `pr-gate` reports live head_sha and ready_to_merge
`pr-gate` reports owner-approval checks as Tier 4 approval_gates (never Tier 3 CI failures) and pending review automation
`pr-gate --stack 12,13,14` gates a stack root-to-tip in tier-major order with contiguous_ready_run, ceiling and lowest_pending_frontier objects (with pr_number), and next_action

Rebase-required trunk drift (overlap or .github/workflows/, including non-ASCII and non-UTF-8 byte paths compared as raw bytes, never failing open) is a Tier 1 blocker; clean, disjoint and lockfile_only are not; fetch=True fetches the exact head (refs/pull/<n>/head fallback) for drift and patch continuity
Merging a stacked PR is refused unless allow_stacked_merge; a rebased head merges only with allow_patch_continuity and an identical patch-id
`restack` keeps patch-id continuity
`worktrees` audit is read-only unless --prune-safe

`publish_pr` refuses (no git push, no gh call, refused publish_pr trail row) on invalid input (including SCP-style/path remotes, unreadable body_file, any caller string (repo, branch, sha, raw title, body, body_file path and content, base, remote, tenant, card_id, actor) that is not a NUL-free UTF-8-encodable str, a branch or resolved base (explicit or persisted default_branch) failing `git check-ref-format refs/heads/<name>` / `--branch` or equal to `@`, and non-boolean draft), unregistered repo, missing checkout, branch == base, missing refs/heads/<branch>, HEAD drift or a remote that is not an exact configured remote name (line match + git remote get-url), still writing a sanitized refused trail row; otherwise pushes `<expected_head_sha>:refs/heads/<branch>`, opens the PR via a temporary --body-file that is always removed, and reports published only after `gh pr view` confirms head and base

`trail --audit` treats malformed evidence pr_number strings (Unicode digits such as '²', overlong digit strings) as absent and returns a structured audit instead of crashing

`recall_decisions` is read-only (absent store stays absent, unversioned store never migrated) and fails closed (ok false, items []) on a directory, dangling symlink or garbage trail.db; `render_recall_markdown` never exceeds max_chars

`recall_decisions` resolves supersession chains (A <- B <- C, branching, cyclic) to the current terminal corrections, never a stale intermediate, emits inline corrections only inside --repo and outside the excluded tenant (else correction_out_of_scope with no correction content), and redacts holdout references from every emitted field including tenant, phase, card_id and nested corrections

`recall_decisions(repo=)` treats owner/repo and its registered or derived slug (or a list of aliases) as one repository, case-insensitively, while distinct repositories such as scope/one and scope/two stay isolated

`recall_decisions` fails closed on the whole field: any emitted string or evidence value referencing holdout becomes exactly [redacted] (no trailing words or path suffix), while prose such as "hold out for review" is left untouched

`contains_holdout_reference` strips complete ANSI CSI/OSC/DCS/C1 escape sequences before matching and also matches the byte-deleted reading, so escape sequences can neither split nor swallow the holdout marker
